description: The plot illustrates the relationship between Initial Confidence and Accuracy for three distinct metrics, one of which has an obscured label in the legend. The x-axis is labeled "Initial Confidence" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.81 to 0.99, with tick marks placed at intervals of 0.01, though the value 0.83 is omitted. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy" and features a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick marks at regular intervals of 0.2. The first line, whose legend label is covered by a grey rectangle, is depicted as a solid blue line with circular markers and error bars. It begins at a value of 1.0 at an initial confidence of 0.81, experiences a slight drop to approximately 0.91 at 0.82, and then fluctuates steadily across the remainder of the x-axis, reaching its lowest point of approximately 0.86 at 0.95 before ending at approximately 0.98 at 0.99. The second line, labeled "Δ Accuracy", is shown as a dashed orange line with diamond markers and error bars. It starts at approximately 0.46 at 0.81 and exhibits a general downward trend with several fluctuations, including notable dips to roughly 0.14 at both 0.86 and 0.89, and a local peak of approximately 0.37 at 0.88, ultimately concluding at its lowest point of approximately 0.04 at 0.99. The third line, labeled "Initial Accuracy", is represented by a dash-dot green line with square markers and error bars. It begins at approximately 0.54 at 0.81 and shows an overall upward trend with fluctuations, including a local peak of approximately 0.76 at 0.86 and a dip to roughly 0.58 at 0.88, before rising to its highest point of approximately 0.94 at the final x-axis value of 0.99.
